question: Can a target-free learned full-width backward-adjoint state expose future closure evidence to J's forward recurrent cell and close the autonomous residual-observability gap?

incumbent.base_choice: Use J, not K. K's pooled full-Gram child regressed the OOF mean and did not solve the hard rows.

bounded_diagnostic.target_use: Only score spatial alignment after each target-free J replay and target-free Jacobian basis is complete.
bounded_diagnostic.interpretation: Reject scalar gain and fixed low-rank correction. Spatial adjoint coordinates contain residual structure, but the persistent hard rows require a full-width learned backward state. The oracle pullback is capacity evidence only and is never a deployment input or performance estimate.

architecture.name: J forward recurrence conditioned by a four-channel learned backward-adjoint smoother
architecture.forward_base: Exact frozen P2R0F2J four-channel signed transport-energy/coherence recurrence.
architecture.backward_order: Compute the complete backward scan L15 down to L2 before the J forward scan.
architecture.backward_adjoint_message: a_15,c=0; for l<15, a_l,c = W_(l+1) @ (Phi_(l+1) * b_(l+1,c)). This is the exact adjoint of the row-vector physical transport s_l=Phi_l*(s_(l-1)@W_l).
architecture.backward_local_input: Native target-free raw20 at layer l, four a_l,c/R_l, and four a_l,c/(sigma_l*R_l), for 28 inputs.
architecture.backward_heads: Layer-specific four-source and four-gain heads; gain=1+0.25*tanh(head+delta_l), mix=I+0.12*tanh(mix_delta_l).
architecture.forward_intervention: Concatenate four b_l,c/R_l and four b_l,c/(sigma_l*R_l) to J's existing 36 local inputs, giving a 44-input H96 J forward cell. The complete backward scan therefore changes forward sources/gains before their errors accumulate to L15.
architecture.reported_correction: J forward channel zero; there is no output-only fusion head.
architecture.material_difference: Unlike scalar damping, W-power scores, Gram pooling, fixed-mode projection, or state-independent Duhamel, M learns state-dependent sources in an exact full-width adjoint recurrence and exposes that future-conditioned spatial state inside J's causal forward recurrence.

training.host_rule: Identical repaired-host rule and eleven data-derived repairs used by J/K.
training.schedule: CosineAnnealingLR over every batch of all six epochs.
training.backward_exposure: Always autonomous; no target residual is ever supplied to the backward scan.
training.loss: J's fit-fold-normalized corrected-layer rollout plus equal final focus; extend the existing 2e-5 normalized auxiliary-state penalty to all four backward states, retain the 5e-4 near-identity gain/mix penalty.
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 6 in every fold; no checkpoint selection.

decision_gate.pass: Only after all unchanged conjuncts pass, meter and prepare a separately frozen native-Q24 transfer.
decision_gate.fail: Close this exact bidirectional spelling measured; do not tune from OOF rows.

cost_contract.authority: Conservative source-structure upper estimate; literal flopscope meter is held until the accuracy gate passes.

native_q24_caveat.compatible_inputs: The metered native-Q24 tape contract already emits live raw20, sigma, Gaussian gate Phi, and the estimator receives all weights. M needs no CP-only field meaning.
native_q24_caveat.accuracy_status: Unproved. CP1792 diagnostic values are capacity-only and are never parity targets or deployment values.
native_q24_caveat.required_next_step: After an observer-fit OOF accuracy pass, freeze and run native-Q24 transfer before any deployment claim.
